UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
CORRIGENDUM - CIVIL SERVICES EXAMINATION, 2026
NOTICE NO. 05/2026-CSP (CORRIGENDUM)
DATED: 15.03.2026

With reference to Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSP dated 14.02.2026 for Civil Services Examination, 2026, it is hereby notified for the information of all candidates that consequent upon receipt of additional requisition from the Department of Personnel and Training (DoPT), the number of vacancies now stands at 1120 instead of 1056.
Other conditions of the original notification shall remain unaltered.
